accepted.title: Critical loop O(n) interfaces converge to their predicted SLE
accepted.text: Let (Ωδ,aδ,bδ) be finite honeycomb-lattice domains of mesh δ approximating a marked simply connected planar domain (Ω,a,b), with a≠b. A configuration consists of one self-avoiding path from aδ to bδ and disjoint closed loops, with weight x^{number of occupied edges}n^{number of loops}, normalized to a probability; for n=0 only the path remains. For each n∈[0,2), at x=x_c(n)=(2+√(2−n))^(−1/2), does the path converge in law, as δ→0, to chordal SLE_κ from a to b in Ω, where κ=4π/(2π−arccos(−n/2))? Curves are considered modulo increasing reparametrization.
accepted.subject: Probability & Planar Lattice Models
accepted.scope_review: Forced single interface and finite-volume loop weights are defined in§17.3.1; this is the dilute critical branch, including the SAW n=0 case. Read source definition rather than merely the formula forκ.
accepted.literature_finding: 2026 primary2508.20917 still describes generic loopO(n) interface/CLE convergence as conjectured and confirms only phase-diagram portions. Known critical Ising n=1 is a proper subcase; no alln convergence theorem located.

accepted.title: Critical square-lattice FK interfaces converge to SLE for all cluster weights
accepted.text: For q∈(0,4], put p=√q/(1+√q). On square-lattice domains Ωδ of meshδ approximating a marked simply connected domain(Ω,a,b), sample edge sets ω with probability proportional to p^{|ω|}(1−p)^{|E\ω|}q^{k(ω)}, wiring the boundary arc from aδ to bδ and leaving the complementary arc free. Let γδ be the medial-lattice exploration path separating the wired primal cluster from the dual cluster adjoining the free arc. Does γδ converge in law, modulo reparametrization, to chordal SLE_κ from a to b, with κ=4π/arccos(−√q/2)?
accepted.subject: Probability & Planar Lattice Models
accepted.scope_review: Positiveq FK probability convention; source q=0 branch is the separately defined limiting UST, already proved. Main universal positiveq target remains. Bond percolation on the square lattice atq=1 must not be replaced by triangular site percolation.
accepted.literature_finding: October6,2026 primary2610.08507 claims CLE₄ convergence for four-state FK/Potts loops; its exact Dobrushin-exploration implications require scope review, so record as fresh partial lead. q=2 FK-Ising convergence is proved. The full positiveq family is not closed by these cases.

accepted.title: Critical self-avoiding parafermionic observable limit
accepted.text: Let(Ωδ,aδ) be honeycomb-lattice domains of meshδ approximating a simply connected proper domainΩ with distinct marked boundary points a,b, and assume the boundary is smooth nearb. For a mid-edge zδ approaching z∈Ω define Fδ(zδ)=Σ_{γ:aδ→zδ}x_c^{|γ|}exp(−5iW(γ)/8), summing self-avoiding paths confined toΩδ, with x_c=(2+√2)^(−1/2) and W the total winding from the initial to the terminal edge direction. If φ:Ω→ℍ sends a to∞ and b to0, must Fδ(zδ)/Fδ(bδ)→(φ′(z)/φ′(b))^(5/8), with a consistently chosen branch?
accepted.subject: Probability & Planar Lattice Models
accepted.scope_review: Explicit winding-weighted path sum, not an arbitrary holomorphic observable. Source normalizes at a smooth boundary pointb, where the boundary derivative is defined. This is distinct from path convergence, though proposed as a route to it.
accepted.literature_finding: Primary author SAW slides identify full observable convergence as the missing point;2026 loop-model paper still treats generic interface convergence as open. No proof of this normalized SAW observable limit found.
